[[EuroLeague]] | team = Crvena zvezda Meridianbet | number = 44 | birth_date = {{birth date and age|2005|08|10|df=y}} | birth_place = [[Novi Sad]], [[Serbia and Montenegro]] | nationality = Serbian | career_start = 2022 | years1 = 2022–present | team1 = [[KK Crvena zvezda|Crvena zvezda]] | years2 = 2022 | team2 = → [[KK Slodes|Slodes]] | years3 = 2023 | team3 = → [[OKK Beograd]] | years4 = 2023 | team4 = → [[KK Mega Basket|Mega]] | highlights = * 2× [[ABA League]] champion ([[2021–22 ABA League First Division|2022]], [[2023–24 ABA League First Division|2024]]) * [[Basketball League of Serbia|Serbian League]] champion (2024) * [[Radivoj Korać Cup|Serbian Cup]] winner (2024) * [[ABA League Top Prospect]] ([[2023–24 ABA League First Division|2024]]) * [[ABA League Ideal Starting Five|All-ABA League Team]] ([[2023–24 ABA League First Division|2024]]) * [[FIBA U18 European Championship]] MVP ([[2023 FIBA U18 European Championship|2023]]) | medal_templates = {{MedalSport|Men's basketball}} {{MedalCountry|{{Flagu|Serbia}}}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA U18 European Championship]]}} {{MedalGold|[[2023 FIBA U18 European Championship|2023 Serbia]]|[[Serbia men's national under-18 basketball team|Team]]}} }} '''Nikola Topić''' ({{lang-sr-cyr|Никола Топић}}, born 10 August 2005) is a Serbian professional [[basketball]] player for [[KK Crvena zvezda|Crvena zvezda]] of the Serbian [[Basketball League of Serbia|KLS]], the [[ABA League|Adriatic League]] and the [[EuroLeague]]. Standing at {{height|ft=6|in=6}}, he plays at the [[point guard]] position. ==Early career== Topić grew up playing basketball for KK Defense from his native [[Novi Sad]] from which he joined the [[KK Crvena zvezda (youth)|Crvena zvezda youth system]] in June 2020.{{cite web |title=Nikola Topić profile |url=https://kkcrvenazvezda.rs/player/nikola-topic/ |website=kkcrvenazvezda.rs |access-date=29 March 2022}}{{cite web |title=Novi potpis u Zvezdi – ugovor za sina legende kluba |url=https://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2020&mm=06&dd=08&nav_id=1692758 |website=b92.net |access-date=29 March 2022}} ==Professional career== ===Crvena zvezda (2022–present)=== On 28 March 2022, Topić made his professional debut for [[KK Crvena zvezda|Crvena zvezda]] in an [[ABA League]] match against Slovenian side [[KK Krka|Krka]] at the age of 16. He scored 4 points and had 5 assists over 16 minutes of playing time. At 16 years, seven months, and eighteen days of age, he became the youngest player in club's history to score points for Crvena zvezda in the ABA League.{{cite web |title= Crvena zvezda mts youngster Nikola Topić sets new club record as the reigning champions beat Krka |url=https://www.aba-liga.com/news/46741/crvena-zvezda-mts-youngster-nikola-topic-sets-new-club-record-as-the-reigning-champions-beat-krka/ |website=aba-liga.com |access-date=29 March 2022}}{{cite web |title=Mladići borovi: Mali Top zakoračio na crveno-beli put Slavnića, Stojakovića, Radmanovića, Kapičića... |url=https://mozzartsport.com/kosarka/vesti/mladici-borovi-mali-top-zakoracio-na-crveno-beli-put-slavnica-stojakovica-radmanovica-kapicica/416088 |website=mozzartsport.com |access-date=29 March 2022}}{{cite web |title=Youngster Nikola Topic enters Zvezda's history books in win over Krka |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/aba/1325900/youngster-nikola-topic-enters-zvezdas-history-books-in-win-over-krka/ |website=eurohoops.net |date=28 March 2022 |access-date=2 April 2022}} On 1 April 2022, Topić made his EuroLeague debut in a 82–57 loss to [[FC Bayern Munich (basketball)|Bayern Munich]],{{cite web |title=FC Bayern Munich 82 57 FINAL Crvena Zvezda mts Belgrade logo Crvena Zvezda mts Belgrade |url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/game-center/2021-22/fc-bayern-munich-crvena-zvezda-mts-belgrade/E2021/293/#boxscore |website=euroleaguebasketball.net |access-date=2 April 2022}} becoming one of [[List of youngest EuroLeague players since the 2000–01 season|youngest players to ever play in the EuroLeague]] at 16 years and 253 days of age. ;2022–23 season At the start of the 2022–23 season, Topić was loaned to the Serbian team [[KK Slodes|Slodes]] in September 2022.{{cite news |title=Nikola Topić i Lazar Trifković na pozajmici u Slodesu |url=https://sportal.blic.rs/kosarka/domaca-kosarka-i-aba/nikola-topic-i-lazar-trifkovic-na-pozajmici-u-slodesu/2022090313162267880 |access-date=3 January 2024 |work=blic.rs |date=3 September 2022 |language=Serbian}} He returned to Crvena zvezda shortly after, and played with the team from October until December of the same year, during which in limited role he averaged 3.4 points over seven ABA League games. On 9 January 2023, the [[ABA League]] declined and cancelled Topić's transfer to [[KK FMP|FMP Meridian]].{{cite web |title=Veliki problemi za Zvezdinog pleja: Nikola Topić ne može da igra za FMP |url=https://www.mozzartsport.com/kosarka/vesti/veliki-problemi-za-zvezdinog-pleja-nikola-topic-ne-moze-da-igra-za-fmp/440325 |website=mozzartsport.com |access-date=10 January 2023}}{{cite web |title=Ništa od transfera, ABA zabranila registraciju Nikole Topića za FMP |url=https://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2023&mm=01&dd=09&nav_id=2271039 |website=b92.net |access-date=10 January 2023}} Eventually, he was loaned to [[OKK Beograd]] for the rest of the 2022–23 season.{{cite web |title=Nikola Topić u OKK Beogradu |url=https://www.mozzartsport.com/kosarka/vesti/nikola-topic-u-okk-beogradu/440362 |website=mozzartsport.com |access-date=10 January 2023}} With OKK Beograd, he appeared in 19 games of the [[2022–23 Basketball League of Serbia|Serbian League]], averaging 17.8 points on 55.2% shooting from the field, 5.3 assists and 3.8 rebounds per game. ;2023–24 season On 17 July 2023, Topić signed his first professional contract with Crvena zvezda.{{cite news |title=NIKOLA TOPIĆ POTPISAO PRVI UGOVOR I POSTAO PRVOTIMAC CRVENE ZVEZDE! |url=https://kkcrvenazvezda.rs/2023/07/17/nikola-topic-potpisao-prvi-ugovor-i-postao-prvotimac-crvene-zvezde/ |access-date=5 January 2024 |work=kkcrvenazvezda.rs |date=17 July 2023 |language=Serbian}} At the start of the 2023–24 season, Topić was loaned to the Serbian team [[KK Mega Basket|Mega]]. He averaged 18.6 points, 6.9 assists and 3.7 rebounds over 13 games, before being loaned back to Crvena zvezda in December 2023.{{cite news |title=NIKOLA TOPIĆ SE VRATIO SVOJOJ KUĆI U CRVENU ZVEZDU! |url=https://kkcrvenazvezda.rs/2023/12/26/nikola-topic-se-vratio-svojoj-kuci-u-crvenu-zvezdu/ |access-date=3 January 2024 |date=26 December 2023 |language=Serbian}} On 4 January 2024, he suffered a knee injury in a game against [[KK Partizan|Partizan Belgrade]].{{cite news |title=NIKOLA SE POVREDIO NA DERBIJU, MORAO U SVLAČIONICU! Ova fotografija će zabrinuti crveno-bele, BOLI GA! |url=https://mondo.rs/Sport/Kosarka/a1873107/Nikola-Topic-se-povredio-na-Zvezda-Partizan-u-Evroligi.html |access-date=3 March 2024 |work=mondo.rs |date=4 January 2024}} On 10 April 2024, he won the [[ABA League Top Prospect]] award after securing more than half of the votes. He averaged 17.9 points, 6.8 assists and 3.6 rebounds when he won the award.{{Cite web |title=Nikola Topic named 2023-24 ABA League Top Prospect |url=https://basketnews.com/news-204472-nikola-topic-named-2023-24-aba-league-top-prospect.html |access-date=2024-04-11 |website=basketnews.com |language=en}} On 13 May 2024, Topić suffered a partially torn [[anterior cruciate ligament|ACL]] in a finals game against [[KK Partizan|Partizan Belgrade]]. ==National team career== In August 2021, Topić was a member of the [[Serbia men's national under-16 basketball team|Serbian under-16 national team]] that participated at the [[2021 FIBA U16 European Challengers|FIBA U16 European Challengers]] in Novi Sad, Serbia. He played only one game, recording 17 points, 8 rebounds, and 5 assists in a 83–52 win over the [[Czech Republic men's national under-17 basketball team|Czech Republic]]. He represented [[Serbia men's national basketball team|Serbian national team]] on his debut on 16 August 2023 where Serbia played friendly match against Puerto Rico. {{cite web |title=2021 U16 Serbia #14 - Nikola TOPIĆ Point Guard |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/europe/challengers/u16/2021/player/Nikola-Topi%C4%87 |website=fiba.basketball |access-date=29 March 2022}}{{cite web |title=Groups B & C [[Coach (basketball)|coach]] and former player.{{cite web |title=KAKAV OTAC – TAKAV SIN: Nikola Topić nastavlja stazama legende Zvezde! |url=https://meridianbetsport.rs/kosarka/nikola-topic-zvezda-milenko-topic/ |website=meridianbetsport.rs |date=28 March 2022 |access-date=30 March 2022}} A [[Power forward (basketball)|power forward]], Milenko spent most of his career in the [[YUBA League]] playing for [[KK Profikolor|Profikolor]], [[KK BFC Beočin|BFC Beočin]], Crvena zvezda as well, [[KK Budućnost Podgorica|Budućnost]], and [[KK Hemofarm|Hemofarm]]. In later career, Milenko played in Italy and Greece. Nikola's father also represented the [[Serbia men's national basketball team|Yugoslavian national team]] internationally (representing [[Serbia and Montenegro|FR Yugoslavia]]), with whom he won gold medals at the [[EuroBasket 1997]] and the [[1998 FIBA World Championship]], a silver medal at the [[Basketball at the 1996 Summer Olympics|1996 Summer Olympics]], and a bronze at the [[EuroBasket 1999]].{{cite web |title=NOVI ZVEZDIN TRENER Ko je Milenko Topić, miljenik navijača i čovek koji je pobedio Olimpijakos u Beogradu |url=https://sport.blic.rs/kosarka/domaca-kosarka-i-aba/novi-zvezdin-trener-ko-je-milenko-topic-miljenik-navijaca-i-covek-koji-je-pobedio/6hjm4zm |website=sport.blic.rs |access-date=30 March 2022}} ==See also== * [[KK Crvena zvezda#Second-generation players|List of father-and-son combinations who have played for Crvena zvezda]] * [[List of youngest EuroLeague players since the 2000–01 season|List of youngest EuroLeague players]] ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== * [https://www.aba-liga.com/player/4120/21/1/nikola-topic/ Nikola Topić] at aba-liga.com * [https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/players/nikola-topic/records/010985/ Nikola Topić] at euroleague.net * [https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Nikola-Topic/Summary/179307 Nikola Topic] at [[realgm.com]] * [https://www.proballers.com/basketball/player/237851/nikola-topic Nikola Topic] at proballers.com {{KK Crvena zvezda current roster}} {{Crvena zvezda 2021–22 ABA League Champions|state=collapsed}} {{ABA League Top Prospect}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Topic, Nikola}} [[Category:2005 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:ABA League players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Novi Sad]] [[Category:KK Crvena zvezda players]] [[Category:KK Mega Basket players]] [[Category:KK Slodes players]] [[Category:OKK Beograd players]] [[Category:Serbian men's basketball players]] [[Category:Point guards]]
